name: Demonic Evasion increases dodge chance (#1385)
contract: Demonic Evasion 705108 increases dodge chance by 5%, via the native SPELL_AURA_MOD_DODGE_PERCENT handler (aura49) applied directly to the unit's dodge percentage. The DBC stores EffectBasePoints 4 with DieSides 1, so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue resolves it to 5 (basePoints+1), one point above the tooltip's 4%.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Demonic Evasion adds 5% dodge chance (EffectBasePoints 4 + 1, DieSides 1)
